resources.string: Sepia runs inside Android System WebView and needs version %1$d or newer. This phone has version %2$d.\n\nUpdate Android System WebView (on some phones it comes with Chrome) from your app store, or install your phone\'s latest system update, then open Sepia again.
Sepia runs inside Android System WebView, and this phone doesn\'t have a working one. It may be turned off in your phone\'s app settings, or it may need an update from your app store.

Sepia works on Android 9, but Google stopped fixing security holes in Android 9 after January 2022. Anything found since then is still open on this phone, and a harmful app or website could use it to reach your photos.\n\nIf you can, keep private photos on a newer phone.
